title: InfiniteNumberIdleSaveSchema
description: Validation schema for Infinite-Number-Idle player save states.

player_id.description: Unique identifier for the local player profile.

infininum_score.description: The current core number packed into the InfiniNum structure.

prestige_points.description: Current available Prestige Points. Maximum limit scales up to ee308.

prestige_count.description: Total number of times forced or manual prestige has been triggered.

prestige_tab_unlocked.description: Permanently set to true once prestige_points hits 10.0.

unlocked_milestones.description: List of unlocked motivational achievement IDs.
